title: Special Executive Programme In E-Commerce
description: The course aims to equip learners with a comprehensive understanding of E-commerce management, infrastructure, strategies, and security.
longDescription: This course provides an in-depth exploration of the dynamic world of E-commerce and M-commerce, covering critical topics such as Internet marketing strategies, E-retailing, network infrastructure, E-business strategies, and the legal frameworks that govern E-commerce operations. Learners will develop the skills needed to manage E-enterprises, understand supply chain management in an online context, and navigate the digital marketplace effectively.
courseDetails: E-commerce infrastructure and elements of e-commerce infrastructure. The network infrastructure for e-commerce. Different types of e-commerce architecture. Broadband telecommunication. Mobile commerce, its types, its applications. Wireless application protocol. Mobile information device profile (midp). E-marketplaces, their types, key success factors of e-marketplace, features of e-marketplaces, and the impact of e-marketplaces on the economy. Compare Conventional Design and E-Organization. Understand E-commerce Enterprise’s Organizational Structure. Understand the concept and dynamics of E-Retailing. Understand and utilize a Conversion Funnel. Understand and apply the concept of E-services. Understand E-commerce Marketing and strategies with the help of case studies Grow Ecommerce by understanding the strategies and barriers to growth. Understand Competitive Advantage, Michael Porter & Sustainable Competitive Advantage. Understand and measure the success of a strategy with the help of cost-benefit analysis and ROI calculation techniques. Understand the process and Requirements of Starting an Online Business and measuring its impact. Understand and apply E-commerce Software systems. Understand E-commerce Websites, along with their types. Understand the concept of Supply Chain Management in E-commerce. Understand Product Sourcing, Strategic Sourcing, Outsourcing, and Offshoring in E-commerce. Understand What is an EFT Payment? And How Do e-Checks Work? Understanding Digital payment systems, currency and Payment Gateways. Understand E-commerce Security Fundamentals and deal with issues arising there. Understand and comply with E-commerce Business Laws and Regulations. Understand Ethics, Social and Political Issues. Learn about the Basic Ethical Concepts: Responsibility, Accountability and Liability. Understand Privacy and Information Rights. Understand What is Customer Data, the Importance of Collecting Customer Data, and Data Collection Methods. Understand the concept of E-Governance and its types. In this course, students will dive into essential topics such as the fundamentals of E-commerce, M-commerce, and E-business, and their differences. They will explore E-commerce infrastructure, network architecture, and strategies for growing online businesses. The course will also cover the importance of legal compliance, security, and ethics in the digital marketplace while offering hands-on learning on starting an online business, measuring its performance, and understanding digital payment systems. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to E-commerce Management: Recognizing the Network Infrastructure of E-commerce and Mobile Commerce: Managing the E-enterprise: Realizing E-Business Strategy and Implementation: Appraising E-commerce Software System: Recognizing the Legal and Security Framework of E-commerce:

modules.title: E-Commerce
modules.summary: This course focuses on the management, technology, and strategic aspects of E-commerce and M-commerce. Students will gain practical insights into managing online businesses, understanding E-enterprise structures, and leveraging E-commerce software systems. Additionally, the course covers the legal and security frameworks crucial to E-commerce, ensuring learners are well-prepared to navigate the modern online business landscape.
